nodes.name: background.rs
nodes.summary: Implements background subagent spawning: launches a subagent session that runs independently of the parent turn and reports back asynchronously.

nodes.name: BackgroundSpawnArgs
nodes.summary: Bundled arguments (agent id, model, prompt, worktree/session config) needed to spawn a background subagent.

nodes.name: foreground.rs
nodes.summary: Implements foreground subagent execution: runs a subagent session to completion synchronously within the parent tool call and returns its result.

nodes.name: ForegroundRunArgs
nodes.summary: Bundled arguments needed to run a foreground subagent to completion.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Shared helper functions and RAII guards used by the agent orchestration tool: subagent id resolution, spawn-rejection policy checks, worktree cleanup, and result formatting.

nodes.name: FinalizeGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that ensures a subagent job is marked finalized (via its Drop impl) even on early return or panic, unless explicitly disarmed.

nodes.name: ResolvedAgentId
nodes.summary: Resolved subagent identifier plus its display label after id/lookup resolution.

nodes.name: ProvisionalJobGuard
nodes.summary: RAII guard that announces and, via Drop, retracts a provisional job entry if the spawn does not complete successfully.

nodes.name: WorktreeCleanup
nodes.summary: Describes how a subagent's git worktree should be disposed of after the run completes (delete, keep, merge).

nodes.name: linked_session.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks and persists "linked session" records that connect a parent agent turn to the subagent sessions it spawned, including instance numbering and status sync.

nodes.name: messages.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the initial conversation message sets for subagents in each launch mode: fresh, forked from parent context, or resumed from a prior session.

nodes.name: InitialMessageMode
nodes.summary: Enum selecting how a subagent's initial messages are constructed: fresh, forked, or resumed.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Implements AgentTool, the central orchestration tool that spawns and manages subagents: resolves identity/policy, builds worktrees and system prompts, and dispatches to foreground or background execution.

nodes.name: DisabledOrgSendMessageTool
nodes.summary: Stub tool returned in place of org_send_message when Agent Org messaging is disabled for the current context.

nodes.name: AgentToolConfig
nodes.summary: Full configuration bundle (allowed subagents, policy, registries, worktree settings) driving a single AgentTool instance.

nodes.name: AgentTool
nodes.summary: The agent orchestration tool itself, exposing subagent spawn/run/manage capabilities to the parent LLM turn.

nodes.name: policy.rs
nodes.summary: Builds tool-permission policies for subagents: which builtin tools are allowed, deny-list overlays for restricted subagent types, and fresh vs inherited policy/registry construction.

nodes.name: spawn_background_subagent
nodes.summary: Spawns a subagent session in the background, wiring up its worktree, registry, and linked-session bookkeeping without blocking the parent turn.

nodes.name: run_foreground_subagent
nodes.summary: Runs a subagent session synchronously to completion, waiting for and returning its final result to the calling agent tool.

nodes.name: optional_nonempty_string_param
nodes.summary: Extracts an optional string parameter, treating empty strings as absent.

nodes.name: subagent_type_label
nodes.summary: Formats a human-readable label for a subagent type/id used in status messages.

nodes.name: resolve_agent_id_for_execute
nodes.summary: Resolves and validates the target agent id for an execute call, applying lookup/normalization rules.

nodes.name: looks_like_valid_subagent_session_id
nodes.summary: Heuristically validates that a string looks like a well-formed subagent session id.

nodes.name: org_roster_spawn_rejection
nodes.summary: Determines whether a subagent spawn must be rejected because the target is an org-roster member not allowed for direct spawning.

nodes.name: subagent_of_subagent_rejection
nodes.summary: Rejects spawn attempts that would create a subagent-of-subagent delegation chain beyond policy limits.

nodes.name: announce
nodes.summary: Publishes a provisional-job announcement event so other parts of the system see the job as pending before it fully starts.

nodes.name: append_result_trailer
nodes.summary: Appends a trailer (agent id, session id, token/tool-use counts) to a subagent's result text for traceability.

nodes.name: count_tool_uses
nodes.summary: Counts the number of tool invocations recorded in a subagent's message history.

nodes.name: background_launch_message
nodes.summary: Builds the acknowledgement message returned to the caller when a background subagent is launched.

nodes.name: resolve_subagent_model
nodes.summary: Resolves which model a subagent should use, applying explicit param, inheritance, and agent-default fallback rules.

nodes.name: dispose_worktree_after_run
nodes.summary: Cleans up (deletes, keeps, or merges) a subagent's git worktree once its run has finished, per WorktreeCleanup policy.

nodes.name: worktree_kept_note
nodes.summary: Builds the note text explaining that a worktree was intentionally kept after a subagent run.

nodes.name: prepend_worktree_note
nodes.summary: Prepends a note to the subagent result explaining that its worktree was kept rather than cleaned up.

nodes.name: with_full_result_pointer
nodes.summary: Appends a pointer/reference to the full untruncated subagent result when the inline result was truncated.

nodes.name: next_instance_number
nodes.summary: Computes the next sequential instance number for a repeatedly-spawned subagent of the same agent id.

nodes.name: write_linked_session
nodes.summary: Persists a new linked-session record connecting a parent session to a freshly spawned subagent session.

nodes.name: update_linked_session_sync
nodes.summary: Synchronous wrapper that applies a linked-session update, used from non-async call sites.

nodes.name: apply_linked_session_update
nodes.summary: Applies a status/token/preview update to an existing linked-session record.

nodes.name: build_initial_messages
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the appropriate message-building strategy based on InitialMessageMode.

nodes.name: build_fork_messages
nodes.summary: Builds initial subagent messages by forking relevant context/history from the parent session.

nodes.name: build_resume_messages
nodes.summary: Builds initial subagent messages by resuming and shrinking a prior subagent session's history.

nodes.name: build_fresh_messages
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal fresh initial message set containing only the system prompt and task prompt.

nodes.name: shrink_oversized_resume_history
nodes.summary: Trims a resumed session's message history down to fit within budget while preserving recent context.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Main execute path for AgentTool: validates the request, resolves policy/model/messages, and dispatches to foreground or background subagent execution.

nodes.name: with_registry_slot
nodes.summary: Constructs an AgentTool wired to shared registry/policy/session-tracking slots inherited from the parent.

nodes.name: requested_isolation
nodes.summary: Determines the requested workspace isolation level (shared vs worktree) for a subagent spawn request.

nodes.name: create_worktree_workspace
nodes.summary: Creates a new git worktree-backed workspace for an isolated subagent session.

nodes.name: with_workspace_coding_overlay
nodes.summary: Overlays coding-tool workspace bindings onto a base tool registry for a subagent's worktree.

nodes.name: build_context
nodes.summary: Builds the delegation context (policy, registry, workspace) used to construct a subagent's AgentTool instance.

nodes.name: agent_supports_builtin_tool
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given agent definition supports a specific builtin tool.

nodes.name: subagent_hard_deny_layer
nodes.summary: Computes the hard deny-list of tools that a subagent may never use regardless of inherited policy.

nodes.name: overlay_parent_exec_mode
nodes.summary: Overlays the parent's execution-mode restrictions onto a subagent's policy.

nodes.name: build_inherited_policy
nodes.summary: Builds a subagent tool policy that inherits and narrows the parent agent's policy.

nodes.name: build_explore_policy
nodes.summary: Builds a restricted read-only "explore" policy for subagents limited to investigation without mutation.

nodes.name: build_fresh_registry
nodes.summary: Builds a brand-new tool registry for a subagent that does not inherit the parent's tool set.

nodes.name: build_fresh_policy
nodes.summary: Builds a brand-new (non-inherited) tool policy for a subagent based solely on its own agent definition.
